description: The file defines the ScreenAuthorizationSubscriber class, which subscribes to kernel controller and exception events to manage access control and authorization for different modules and screens within the OrangeHRM system. It implements logic to check user permissions and handle forbidden access exceptions.

classes.name: ScreenAuthorizationSubscriber
classes.description: A subscriber class that listens to kernel controller and exception events to enforce security and access permissions on screens and modules within the OrangeHRM system. It uses multiple traits for dependency injection and utility functions.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array mapping kernel events (controller and exception) to handler methods with their priority.

methods.name: onControllerEvent
methods.description: Handles controller events to check if the current user has permissions to access the targeted module and screen, throwing ForbiddenException if not authorized.

methods.name: onExceptionEvent
methods.description: Handles exception events to catch ForbiddenExceptions and responds with a forbidden access page.

methods.name: getControllerInstance
methods.description: Retrieves the controller instance from the event's controller array.
